newsitem.title: USA: Synaptx merges with Worldwide Applied.
newsitem.headline: Synaptx merges with Worldwide Applied.

text.p: Synaptx Worldwide Inc said it completed a merger agreement on March 12 and plan of reorganization with Worldwide Applied Telecom Technology Inc.
In the transaction, Synaptx issued 3.6 million shares and changed its name from In-Touch Interactive Multimedia Inc.
Synaptx, which now has 5.0 million common shares issued and outstanding, said it is now traded on the Electronic Bulletin Board.

The company said it plans to accelerate efforts to acquire, improve and eventually spin out as separate public companies its target acquisitions, manufacturing and software providers in the telecommunications industry.
Synaptx said it recently completed its first two acquisitions -- North American Telco/Cable Representatives Inc and Maxwell Partners Inc.
